components.css: .ds-btn-send { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4F6B28; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-send:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F6B28; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Corner Button
components.description: Floating white circular corner control (CV download, contact, music).
components.css: .ds-btn-corner { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #141814; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8) inset, 0 6px 18px -8px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.22); transition: box-shadow 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-corner:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -4px rgb(76 60 30 / 0.10); transform: scale(1.06); } .ds-btn-corner:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4F6B28; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Pill
components.description: Floating white pill of text nav items with a highlighted active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; background: #fff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 5px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8) inset, 0 2px 8px -2px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.10), 0 12px 28px -16px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.18); } .ds-nav-item { font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgb(20 24 20 / 0.55); padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, background 150ms; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #141814; background: #F2EBD9; } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #141814; background: #FAF4E8; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(76 60 30 / 0.04); }

components.name: Chat Bar
components.description: The hero interaction — a white rounded pill with a borderless input and a moss send button.
components.css: .ds-chatbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 8px 8px 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8) inset, 0 2px 8px -2px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.10), 0 12px 28px -16px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.18); width: 380px; max-width: 100%; } .ds-chatbar-input { flex: 1; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #141814; } .ds-chatbar-input::placeholder { color: rgb(20 24 20 / 0.55); } .ds-chatbar-send { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4F6B28; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-chatbar-send:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }

components.name: Polaroid Card
components.description: The signature object: white paper with a fat bottom lip, soft warm shadow, slight rotation, draggable.
components.css: .ds-polaroid { background: #fff; padding: 8px 8px 32px; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.6) inset, 0 10px 24px -12px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.18), 0 30px 60px -30px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.22); width: 180px; transform: rotate(-3deg); cursor: grab; user-select: none; transition: box-shadow 200ms, transform 200ms; } .ds-polaroid:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7) inset, 0 14px 30px -10px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.28), 0 40px 80px -28px rgb(68 60 40 / 0.32); transform: rotate(-1deg) translateY(-4px); } .ds-polaroid-thumb { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C5D4A8, #F7DFA0); } .ds-polaroid-label { margin-top: 14px; text-align: center; font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; color: #141814; }

narrative.overview: A living garden you wander through, not a page you read. Polaroid cards drift in warm late-afternoon light, bloom outward from center on first arrival, float gently at rest, and can be picked up and tossed around. The whole surface breathes: a soft radial wash from cream center to sage edge, blurred organic color blooms in the corners, and a faint multiply grain so nothing ever looks flat or screen-born. The personality is warm and human first, with confident craft underneath and a playful, springy streak in every interaction. The medium is the proof: the draggable scatter, the working motion, and the tactility are the case study for a designer who codes. It explicitly rejects the corporate-agency showreel, the editorial-magazine portfolio, the SaaS landing page, and cold techie cosplay. It is a garden, a desk, a scrapbook — never a dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream-to-sage garden surface, never a flat white screen
Polaroid cards as the primary object: paper, soft shadow, slight rotation, draggable
Springy, living motion — bloom, float, drift, spring-back — over static states
Moss green as the single anchor accent in a soft naturalistic palette
Fraunces italic for voice; Manrope for plain-spoken body; mono only for tiny labels
Tactile depth via warm diffuse shadows; hard crisp shadows are forbidden

rules.name: The Warm-Surface Rule
rules.body: The page is never a flat white screen. Content sits on the cream garden wash (#F5EFE1 toward sage), and white (#FFFFFF) is reserved exclusively for objects that lift off it. A large flat white panel filling the viewport means the garden has been paved over.

rules.name: The One-Green-Voice Rule
rules.body: Moss (#4F6B28) is the only saturated accent that carries meaning, on a small fraction of any screen. Sage, coral, and butter are atmospheric seasoning, never primary CTAs.

rules.name: The Transparency-Not-Gray Rule
rules.body: Muted text is a transparency of ink (#141814 @ 55%), never a separately picked gray, which goes muddy on the warm surface.

rules.name: The Italic-Voice Rule
rules.body: Display and title type is Fraunces italic, not roman. The slant is the personality.

rules.name: The Eyebrow-Restraint Rule
rules.body: The tiny tracked mono uppercase label is permitted only as an occasional structural marker, never stacked above every section.

rules.name: The Warm-Diffuse Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is brown-warm and soft-blurred. Crisp, dark, neutral-gray shadows are forbidden.

rules.name: The Lift-Is-Alive Rule
rules.body: Elevation responds to interaction: rest then hover then drag escalates the shadow each step.

dos: Do keep content on the warm garden surface (#F5EFE1); reserve pure white (#FFFFFF) for objects that lift off it.
Do use moss (#4F6B28) as the single meaningful accent, on a small fraction of any screen.
Do set display and title type in Fraunces italic with the opsz/SOFT axes; let weight and slant carry hierarchy.
Do make depth warm, soft, and diffuse, and escalate it across rest, hover, drag.
Do give interactions a springy, living response — bloom, float, drift, spring-back.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with calm/instant fallbacks for bloom, float, and peek transitions.
Do treat muted text as a transparency of ink (#141814 @ 55%) and verify body/placeholder text clears WCAG AA on cream.
donts: Don't pave the garden with a large flat white panel filling the viewport.
Don't build the corporate-agency showreel — no cinematic scroll-hijack, no full-bleed video spectacle.
Don't default to the editorial-magazine lane: roman display-serif slab + tracked uppercase eyebrow on every section + broadsheet grid.
Don't introduce SaaS landing-page clichés — feature grids, hero-metric templates, testimonial carousels, CTA stacks.
Don't dress it in cold techie costume — no monospace-everything, terminal tropes, or dark-mode-because-coding.
Don't use crisp, dark, or neutral-gray shadows; warm and diffuse only.
Don't stack tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows as section grammar.
Don't pick a separate gray for muted text.
Don't set headlines in upright Fraunces; the italic slant is the brand voice.
